description: This file is a PHP source code defining the 'Account' controller class within the OpenCart admin extension modules. It implements methods for routing and handling account module settings, including rendering the settings page and saving configuration data.

classes.name: Account
classes.description: Controller class for managing the account module settings in the OpenCart admin extension. It provides methods to display and save configuration options.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles rendering the account module configuration page in the admin panel. Loads language, sets the page title, prepares breadcrumb navigation, and gathers data for the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes POST requests to save the account module settings. Checks user permissions, validates input, saves settings via the model, and returns a JSON response indicating success or error.
